name: bibliograph-mcp
description: Japan-studies bibliographic and archival search: NDL, WARP, CiNii Research, J-STAGE, JDCat, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and Japanese name/authority lookup, plus open-access PDF fetch with provenance, with typed envelopes and query receipts.
long_description: One MCP server gathering the sources a Japan-studies search needs: the National Diet Library's catalogue, national bibliography, magazine index and Digital Collections (metadata and OCR full text), the WARP web archive, CiNii Research (articles, books, dissertations, KAKEN, researchers), J-STAGE, the JDCat humanities and social-science data catalogue, OpenAlex and the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph, plus Japanese name and authority resolution. Every tool answers with one typed JSON envelope: the term actually sent and its script, how the source matched it, how broad the set is, typed diagnostics, a receipt hash and the provider's attribution. Receipts can be deposited to an append-only, hash-chained ledger so a search behind a footnote can be named and re-run. Load a subset with the BIBLIOGRAPH_ONLY setting below. Needs no Python of its own: Claude Desktop builds the bundle's environment with uv (one on the PATH if present, otherwise a copy the app downloads) when the extension is installed (a Python 3.10 or later already on the machine is used; one is downloaded only if there is none), and every launch reuses it and takes under a second.

cinii_appid.title: CiNii application ID
cinii_appid.description: Your own NII CiNii/NRID application id. Enables the researcher-number (NRID) step; other CiNii Research calls run without it.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: Optional. OpenAlex works without a key.

openalex_email.title: Contact email (Crossref polite pool)
openalex_email.description: Optional but recommended: a contact address. Crossref uses it to place requests in its faster 'polite pool'; OpenAlex no longer reads it.

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Optional but recommended: free from semanticscholar.org. Keyless calls share one throttled pool.

receipts_dir.title: Receipts folder
receipts_dir.description: Where this server deposits its append-only, hash-chained query receipts (one <source>.jsonl per source). Leave empty to run without receipts; the envelope will then say RECEIPT_NOT_DEPOSITED.

receipt_session.title: Receipt session slug
receipt_session.description: A project or article slug stamped on every receipt, e.g. my-article-2026. Optional.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where fetch_pdf saves open-access PDFs, each with a provenance file beside it. Leave empty and fetch_pdf and fetch_pdf_text refuse with DOWNLOAD_DIR_NOT_SET; nothing is written anywhere.

bibliograph_only.title: Sources to load (optional)
bibliograph_only.description: Comma-separated source keys to load instead of all of them, e.g. ndl,cinii,jstage. Leave empty to load every source. See the README for the full list of keys.
